body.p: Claims 1, 4-10, 13-17, and 20 are pending. Claims 1-2, 4-11, and 14-18 are rejected and claims 3, 12-13, and 19-20 are objected to. Claims 1, 10, 13, 17, and 20 are amended. Claims 2, 3, 11, 12, and 18-19 are canceled. No new matter has been added.
First Claim Rejection - 35 USC § 103

Claims 1, 10, and 17 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. §103 as being unpatentable over Holland (WO 2021/216060 Al), and further in view of Sawhney (US 2019/0392212 Al). This rejection is respectfully traversed.
However, to expedite the prosecution of the present patent application, claim 1 is

amended to include most of the recitations of allowable claim 3. Also, claim 10 is amended to include most of the recitations of allowable claim 13, and claim 17 is amended to include most of the recitations of allowable claim 19. As such, the independent claims 1, 10, and 17 are submitted to be in condition for allowance.
Therefore, it is respectfully requested that the section 103 rejection of claims 1, 10, and 17 be withdrawn.
Second Claim Rejection -35 USC § 103

Claims 2, 11 and 18 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Holland in view of Sawhney and further in view of Chen (US 2023/0147573 Al). This rejection is respectfully traversed. Claims 2, 11, and 18 have been canceled.
Therefore, it is respectfully requested that the section 103 rejection of claims 2, 11, and 18 be withdrawn.
Third Claim Rejection - 35 USC § 103
Claim 4 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. §103 as being unpatentable over Holland in view of Sawhney and further in view of Gardner (US 2023/0158409 Al). This rejection is respectfully traversed.
Claim 4 depends from independent claim 1, which is submitted to be in condition for allowance. Therefore, it is respectfully requested that the section 103 rejection of claim 4 be withdrawn.
Fourth Claim Rejection - 35 USC § 103
Claims 5 and 14 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. §103 as being unpatentable over
Holland in view of Sawhney, and further in view of Flaks (US 8,767,968 B2). This rejection is respectfully traversed.

Claim 5 depends from independent claim 1 and claim 14 depends from independent claim 10. Both claims 1 and 10 are submitted to be in condition for allowance. Hence, the dependent claims 5 and 14 are in condition for allowance. Therefore, it is respectfully requested that the section 103 rejection of claims 5 and 14 be withdrawn.
Fifth Claim Rejection - 35 USC § 103
Claim 6 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. §103 as being unpatentable over Holland in view of Sawhney, and further in view of Nuernberger (US 2017/0287218 Al). This rejection is respectfully traversed.

Claim 6 depends from independent claim 1. Claim 1 is submitted to be in condition for allowance. Hence, the dependent claim 6 is in condition for allowance. Therefore, it is respectfully requested that the section 103 rejection of claim 6 be withdrawn.
Sixth Claim Rejection - 35 USC § 103
Claim 7 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Holland in view of Sawhney, and further in view of Dascola (US 2019/0228589 Al). This rejection is respectfully traversed.

Claim 7 depends from independent claim 1. Claim 1 is submitted to be in condition for allowance. Hence, the dependent claim 7 is in condition for allowance. Therefore, it is respectfully requested that the section 103 rejection of claim 7 be withdrawn.
Seventh Claim Rejection - 35 USC § 103
Claim 8 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Holland in view of Sawhney, and further in view of Hijazi (US 2022/0392478 Al). This rejection is respectfully traversed.

Claim 8 depends from independent claim 1. Claim 1 is submitted to be in condition for allowance. Hence, the dependent claim 8 is in condition for allowance. Therefore, it is respectfully requested that the section 103 rejection of claim 8 be withdrawn.
Eighth Claim Rejection - 35 USC § 103
Claims 9 and 16 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. §103 as being unpatentable over
Holland in view of Sawhney, and further in view of Wang (US 2019/0236416). This rejection is respectfully traversed.

Claim 9 depends from independent claim 1 and claim 16 depends from independent claim 10. Both claims 1 and 10 are submitted to be in condition for allowance. Hence, the dependent claims 9 and 16 are in condition for allowance. Therefore, it is respectfully requested that the section 103 rejection of claims 9 and 16 be withdrawn.
Ninth Claim Rejection - 35 USC § 103
Claim 15 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. §103 as being unpatentable over Holland in view of Sawhney, and further in view of Yeung (SU 2020/0388068 Al). This rejection is respectfully traversed.

Claim 15 depends from independent claim 10. Claim 10 is submitted to be in condition for allowance. Hence, the dependent claim 15 is in condition for allowance. Therefore, it is respectfully requested that the section 103 rejection of claim 15 be withdrawn.
Claims 3, 12-13, and 19-20 have been indicated as allowable. Applicant sincerely
thanks the Examiner for the indication of allowable subject matter. Claims 3, 12-13, and 19- 20 have been canceled.
In view of the amendments above, a Notice of Allowance is respectfully requested.

If the Examiner has any questions concerning the present amendment, the Examiner is kindly requested to contact the undersigned at (408) 749-6911.
